description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Transportation Engineering topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: transportation-engineering

facts.claim: A road is a way open to public traffic

source.quote: A road is a thoroughfare from one place to another, primarily used for movement of traffic

facts.claim: Highway planning estimates current and future traffic volumes

source.quote: Highway planning involves the estimation of current and future traffic volumes on a road network

facts.claim: Good drainage raises pavement bearing capacity and life

source.quote: The bearing capacity and service life of a pavement can be raised significantly by arranging good drainage

facts.claim: SSD = distance during perception–reaction time plus braking distance

source.quote: Stopping sight distance is the distance traveled during the two phases of stopping a vehicle: perception-reaction time (PRT), and maneuver time (MT)

facts.claim: Enough sight distance lets a driver stop before an obstacle

source.quote: a near worst-case distance a vehicle driver needs to be able to see in order to have room to stop before colliding

facts.claim: Superelevation banks the road toward the inside of the curve

source.quote: the roadbed having a transverse down-slope towards the inside of the curve

facts.claim: At the design (rated) speed no friction is needed

source.quote: The magnitude of this velocity is also known as the "rated speed"

facts.claim: Crest and sag vertical curves join grades; they are parabolic

source.quote: The profile of a road consists of road slopes, called grades, connected by parabolic vertical curves

facts.claim: Flow, speed and density are related (q = k × v)

source.quote: Key traffic stream variables include speed, flow, and density, which are interconnected

facts.claim: Red stop, amber change, green go

source.quote: The usual traffic light colors are red to stop traffic, amber to signal a change, and green to allow traffic to proceed

facts.claim: Asphalt concrete is aggregate bound with bitumen

source.quote: It consists of mineral aggregate bound together with bitumen

facts.claim: CBR measures subgrade strength by a standard penetration test

source.quote: The CBR test is a penetration test in which a standard piston, with a diameter of 50 mm (1.969 in), is used to penetrate the soil

facts.claim: Flexible pavements have layers (surface, base, sub-base) over the subgrade

source.quote: A flexible, or asphalt, or Tarmac pavement typically consists of three or four layers

facts.claim: It bends slightly under load and recovers

source.quote: because of the asphalts ability to bend and deform slightly, then return to its original position

facts.claim: Rigid pavements are mostly Portland cement concrete slabs

source.quote: Portland cement concrete (PCC) is the most common material used in the construction of rigid pavement slabs
